_about: TRANSLATOR SHELF: John Cournos (1881-1966) as translator: Sologub's The Created Legend (1916) and The Old House and Other Tales (1915). His Little Demon is on aldington_shelf.json. Printings before 1931 only. US public domain. Added 2026-10-10 by lane C (round 30); Adam may veto. No uids minted. From archive.org (2026-10-23): Short Stories out of Soviet Russia (Dutton, 1929).
